description: List the procedural sound effect presets (Eastern wuxia/xianxia sounds and general game sounds) with category, tags and what each is good for. Optionally filter by category (combat, magic, instrument, ui, items, character, ambience, creature) or a search query such as "metal", "calm" or "sword". Every call to generate_sfx with a preset gives a new random variation; pass a seed to reproduce one.

query.description: Words that must all match the name, description, keywords or tags

name: list_presets
title: List sound presets
